delivery.summary: 声音评审后整改：撞钟加长加厚（嗡音约 45 秒、撞木闷响、山坡回声），脚步室外近乎无混响并加响、按落脚时刻发声，檐下滴水只在雨后，脚步补来源登记。
changes: instruments.js：bell() 与 hillEcho()，嗡音撞后涌起约 45 秒、基音约 34 秒、高分音先散；撞木闷响代替清脆起音；撞钟时音乐让位 14 秒
audio.js：脚步单独一路送混响（室外 0.07、殿内 0.4），仍受「音效」滑杆控制；每步在落脚后固定 60 毫秒发声（monk.steps[].late），慢帧也不乱拍
steps.js：LEVEL 干石、湿石 +6 dB，水洼 +5 dB，雪 +4 dB，次序不变
檐下滴水只在雨后（夏多春少），秋天和雪天没有
SOURCES.md 补脚步一行并更新大钟、滴水、混响三行；MUSIC.md 音效列表加脚步
测试：bell.test.mjs；monk.test.mjs 检查落脚时刻；sound 场景补上被注释吞掉的等帧，竹击和鸟叫改为真的听山声总线，钟声 8 秒后仍在
进度随时保存（所有者要求）：位置每两秒和离开页面时保存；回来时标题页盖在上回所在处，给「接着走」和「从头走起」（后者问两次，清空朱印从竹径走起），并写明「上回走到某处」；首次到访仍只有「入山」
朱印帐当地图（所有者要求）：翻开朱印帐，点一枚已得的印，合帐、暗场、回到得印的那一处
移动端界面（所有者要求）：页面自带 doctype 与 viewport（此前线上页面没有，手机上按约 980 像素宽缩小显示）；触控目标不小于 44 像素；歇脚菜单不高过屏幕并可上下拖动，底部一排固定，横握时分两栏；画作卡片的「看过了」吸在底部；禁止橡皮筋回弹与长按选字；新增 tools/mobile-audit.cjs（修改前列出 60 项，修改后 0 项）

selection.reason: Collision, photo, novice, statues, music and UI layer changes. Static, unit, selected e2e and real-input checks were run; visual inspection covered the six fixed cameras and the photo flow.

checks.criterion: 锁定提交单元回归通过
checks.reason: 108/108 unit tests passed in a credential-free subprocess.

checks.criterion: 评审结构/证据校验器自身回归通过
EDGE-001/002 在锁定计划上的碰撞几何
checks.reason: Developer tool `edges` reports 0 cm over for all 15 groups. Independent probe: at all 8 front-eave columns of the previous finding the nearest free centre is post radius + 0.377 m + 0.5–0.7 cm; both tea tables are blocked everywhere within 0.45 m of their centres. This is walker geometry only; animated robe envelope and normal-speed video are not covered.

checks.criterion: 受影响 e2e 场景在锁定提交通过
checks.reason: SwiftShader, serial. Passed: boot, layers, menu, photo-ui, keys, jump, drop, stairs, phone, halls (phone/halls after a rerun: the first run was killed by this review's own 1500 s timeout). Failed: camera (stale assertion that a drag turns the photo camera, contradicting the intended zoom-only design; harness, high confidence; fixed later in 53d7862, not retested here); music and sound (drum assertions sample 150 ms of wall clock after the strike; under SwiftShader each __listen takes ~600 ms and the drum has already decayed; a diagnostic shows the drum sounding at 54 Hz; harness/environment, medium confidence). First failures kept.

checks.criterion: 完整五区往返可由正常速度实际输入完成
checks.reason: Playwright keyboard/mouse events at normal speed (no ?cam, ?fast, __walk or __pose): entered from the title and climbed from the bamboo start (h −14.5) to the first landing (h −10.5). Holding W straight on then walked off the paving onto the leaf-litter slope and stopped against an invisible boundary (UX-08). The zigzag, gate, first court and the return were not covered. Automated input is not a human recording.

checks.criterion: 歇脚菜单打开时背景不响应输入
checks.reason: With the menu open, E, B, P, T, H, V, Enter, Space, held W and the wheel changed nothing: stack stayed [menu], no movement, view and camera distance unchanged. Tapping the ground and dragging behind the menu were not covered by this run.

checks.criterion: 留影：风景优先、简洁界面、远近都清晰、默认16:9横幅
checks.reason: Raised camera shows only 收起/设置/快门; the print shows near paving and far bamboo both sharp, so there is no depth of field; the figure is optional (入画 off by default). The default frame is 全幅 (screen aspect, 1700×1130 here; tall on a portrait phone), not the 16:9 横幅 the goal names.

checks.criterion: 六个固定机位与既有美术问题
checks.reason: cam01–cam06 rendered with no page errors and were opened one by one. Wet paving in cam06 is more matte with softer puddles; the stair edges in cam01 are better. Flat bright sky (ART-02), brush-like cedars (ART-10), sky gaps in bamboo (ART-07) and uniform wall weathering (ART-05) remain.

checks.criterion: 殿内墨画、雕塑与新蒙皮小沙弥
checks.reason: Third-person novice seen in the real-input screenshots (A-pose-derived figure, hat on back). The halls scenario passed but no interior screenshot was opened; museum statues and ink paintings were not visually checked.

checks.criterion: 锁定目标 Mac 与手机各完成 120秒×3 性能测量
checks.reason: No target device. SwiftShader drew about 0.4 frames/s at 1280×720; this says nothing about any device. Historical T4 numbers are not extrapolated.

checks.criterion: 素材来源、再分发授权与仓库许可完整可核
checks.reason: Buddha and pedestal licence still 'NOT RECORDED - owner to confirm'; the repository has no LICENSE file. New museum statue scans are recorded with sources but their terms were not independently verified.

checks.criterion: 仓库状态与部署信息不夸大验收
checks.reason: Status JSON reported source and deployment 9e78569 with CI scope boot only and showed the old review as not applicable. CI success is provenance, not acceptance. The research Site's llms.txt still lists the 954f84d review as the latest independent review.

checks.criterion: 配乐：可辨认主题、过渡与混音的听评
checks.reason: No one has listened. Automated scenarios only show buses, ducking and no overlap. Aesthetic acceptance needs a real listening session and a device recording.

issues.title: 前檐柱与角色体积相交，影响八座殿堂
issues.finding: 角色中心止于柱前约0.45–0.46m，但衣袍进入柱身。实际模型静止采样穿入保守柱芯约5.1–11.1cm；行走姿态约8.7–14.7cm。浏览器普通W从前廊诊断点可达到该边界。
issues.recommendation: 按角色体积与可见动画包络处理共享碰撞；覆盖全部前檐柱并保留门口与前廊通行。方案由Claude选择，不能仅缩小/隐藏人物或封死通路。
issues.goal: 玩家走近、转身、奔跑和落地时，衣袍、身体与随身物均不进入柱身/柱础。
acceptance: 茶寮、禅堂、大雄宝殿、藏经楼、药师殿、大慧院、观音殿、凌霄阁全部前檐柱逐一检查，补山门/亭子柱基。
正向、斜向、贴边转身、倒退、Shift和跳跃/落地均无持续可见穿插；几何误差≤1cm。
柱间、楼梯、入口与前廊保持可达，提供同机位前后图和正常速度连续录像。
issues.retest_note: 9e78569: walker geometry now holds (independent probe, A-POST-PROBE/A-EDGE-PROBE); animated envelope, turning/backing/Shift/jump and normal-speed before/after video still required to close.

issues.recommendation: 茶案与桌腿具有匹配可见体积的阻挡；合法绕行和原下台阶点继续可用。
issues.goal: 角色可以绕过茶案，到达入口与下台阶点，不能走进桌板或桌腿。
